pos.personaBrief: Jesus's Benfica built from the back (Coaches' Voice, Cruyff influence) and pressed high, but scored mostly in fast transitions (Bola na Rede 2014). It controlled games more through pressing and territory than a possession-for-its-own-sake approach.

pro.personaBrief: Vertical, fast play and transition goals (Bola na Rede: 'rapido e vertical') with a goalkeeper advanced in build-up. Midfielders like Enzo Perez and Fejsa were solid ball-winners who also distributed.

est.personaBrief: Rehearsed, highly organised model with defined zonal roles and ideas held 'as sacred commandments' (Record), yet wingers drifted infield (Coaches' Voice, Gaitan).

lar.personaBrief: Fast breaks specifically targeted the flanks (Bleacher Report) and Rodrigo was a constant right-flank threat, though wingers also cut inside to cross or shoot. Strikers and the central pair also scored a lot.

blo.personaBrief: Very high aggressive pressing with the back line near midfield and forwards pressing the first pass (Il Post, Bleacher Report, Bola na Rede), with a compact mid-block as fallback.

mar.personaBrief: Exclusively zonal marking in open play and on set pieces, with no individual marking (Bola na Rede).

pla.personaBrief: The model stayed constant ('as ideias fortes ... mantiveram-se sempre'); Jesus imposed his idea and pressed high even against Juventus.

res.personaBrief: Attacking, vertiginous football aiming to win, going for wins away from home too; Europa League run unbeaten. Jesus believes in playing better through method.

sis.personaBrief: System-driven, with everyone defending (Rodrigo dropping back, Lima's defensive work) and ordinary players improved by the method (Enzo Perez repositioned).

jog.personaBrief: Intense, aggressive team with strong, aerial centre-backs (192cm, set-piece goals), but Enzo Perez and Fejsa valued for passing and reading rather than just force.

bas.personaBrief: Mixed squad with 19-21 year olds (Markovic, Oblak) given roles, but mostly bought players and rotation of experienced ones.

lid.personaBrief: Jesus defends ideas as sacred commandments and trains obsessively (Record, Enzo Perez); a firm, authoritarian coach.
